originalTitle: A finite multi-cut certificate theorem, with penultimate lag 211 application
originalStatement: Distinct bottom cuts require distinct residual top lags. A Hall deficiency therefore excludes a P-position. A phase-aware finite induction certificate with independent periodic rails yields f(b,b−1)>b+211 for every b≥600.
originalHypotheses: Certified external periodic rail families, complete reply identities, finite seed window and explicit state/cut certificates. No arbitrary-lag or free-lag theorem.
independence: Proof reconstructed from primary arguments and explicit definitions. Earlier source status/review assertions were not treated as proof. The author previously collected these sources; the present derivations and finite/exact-algebra checks are new independent audit work.
detailedDerivation: Assuming X=(b+k,b,b−m) isP, every legal bottom-cut Y_t isN and has aP reply. Complete legal move enumeration, after removing replies already reachable fromX, yields typeI E(k+j,m+t−j;b−j), typeII E(0,h;b−m−t+h), and typeIII E(ell,m+t;b), with the stated strictly positive/backward ranges.

If all I/II candidates areN and surviving III lags lie inL_t, two cuts cannot reuse a lag: their twoP positions have equal top/middle but different bottom, and the larger-bottom one moves to the smaller. Hence selected cuts inject into the union of residual lags, contradicting a cardinality deficit.

A finite state family is proved by outer induction onb and inner induction onk. I/II supports decreaseb by1..J; III supports decreasek in the same row. J consecutive verified base rows prevent any backward edge skipping belowT. Correct shifted phases and cut legality must be checked for each support.

The periodic prefix lemma is independently reconstructed: inherited/pre-q0 values are belowT, old pattern awards more thanG rows earlier are below currentb, and only the lastG awards contribute nonnegative normalized offsets. LIVE-FLOOR blocks lower labels, and finite normalized MEX identities close induction inb then incolumn.

Independent support reading checks8431 unique states, every residual union/deficit and all1,355,278 support calls (the extra424 are target coverage calls). All targetlags0..211 are covered. Thus f(b,b−1)>b+211 for everyb≥600.

For the source’s neighboring-W corollary W is the set ofP targets, not an outcome bit. At b≤a<d(b), second-row targets of X=(a,b,b) andY=(a,b,b−1) agree, and third-row target lists differ only byY. First-rowX has noP target; first-rowY has one iff f(b,b−1)<a. If f>a, both first-row lists are empty andY isN, proving equality. If f=a,Y itself is the extraP target; if f<a, target(f,b,b−1) is reachable fromY and no one-move channel ofX. Thus equality iff f>a.
